limitations: Every assigned supplemental case lacks an independent exact-state reference PNG; all four comparisons are limited to related layout and behavior.

Visible compact title and chapter labels are accepted only as actually read. Exact typeface, numeric font weight and pixel equivalence were not measured; this is a limitation, not an unreadable-detail pending item.

Action/state/provider records are independent static behavioral support. No local or remote application, tests, builds, probes, SQL queries, hashes, image processing, crops or resizing were performed.
